### Resolve\<T>(Action\<T>, Func\<T, bool>) {#resolve-1-0-boolean}

Yields until T is registered, then hands it over. Hands over null once module
registration has finished without it - that scene simply has no such module.
Optionally keeps waiting until the service reports itself usable; once a module
has registered we wait for its data however long that takes.
